alreadyFirst: This link is already the first one.
alreadyLast: This link is already the last one.
editPlace: This link is at position {n} of {total}. Below the form, the Move up and Move down buttons change the order of the icons on the site.
empty: No links yet. Add the first one with the form below: just paste the address of your page.
err_choice: Pick one of the options in the list.
err_confirm: Tick the box to confirm the removal.
err_label_needed: Give this link a name, for example “My shop”.
err_limit: You already have {max} links: remove one before adding another.
err_notfound: This link no longer exists. Reload the page.
err_platform: Pick a platform from the list.
err_url_credentials: Remove the name and password from the address: write only, for example, {example}.
err_url_duplicate: This address is already in the list.
err_url_empty: Paste the address of your page, for example {example}.
err_url_http: Only secure addresses (https) are accepted. Write for example {example}.
err_url_internal: This is not the address of a public site. Write for example {example}.
err_url_invalid: This address is not understood. Write it without spaces, for example {example}.
err_url_long: This address is too long. Paste the address of the page itself, for example {example}.
err_url_platform: This address is not on {platform}. Write for example {example}, or choose “Other” for another site.
err_url_scheme: Write a web site address, for example {example}.
fLabelHelp: Shown when the icon is hovered and read by screen readers. Required for “Other”.
fOrigin: Tell the platform where the visitor comes from
fUrlHelp: Paste the address, even without “https://”. Example: onlyfans.com/yourname. For a platform in the list, your name alone is enough.
fVisible: Show the icon on the site
fWarnHelp: Depends on the platform: yes for OnlyFans, Mym and Fansly, no for the others (set in the Settings tab). Choose “No” if this link is not adult content.
intro: Each link becomes an icon at the top of the site, next to your social networks. For each link you choose whether a notice page (“adult content”) appears first.
introWarn: An OnlyFans link is not necessarily adult content: turn the notice off for all links in the Settings tab, or for a single link. This page only gives notice: it does not check age and does not replace what the law of your country may require.
limitNote: Click “Edit” to change a link, move it up or down, or remove it. The top of the site shows at most 10 icons in all, social networks included: the following ones are not shown.
p_message: This link leads to a site for adults only (18 and over).
p_missing_message: It may have been removed or changed. You can go back to the site.
readOnly: You can view this list, but not change it.
removeConfirm: Yes, remove this link from the site
